source.table: RECOMMENDED CUTTING CONDITIONS - INCH, 7 FLUTES (TitaNox-Power HPC) - Side Cutting & Trochoidal Milling (SERIES HHK82)
source.cells: VDI 3323 14.1 Stainless steel (SUS 316, 316, X5CrNiMo 17 12 2); Ae 0.05D, Ap 3D; column 1/8 in: SFM 510; IPT .0009; RPM 15590; IPM 96

tool.series: TitaNox-Power HPC 7-flute standard length square end HHK82 (unequal index, 38 deg)

vendor_notes: Feed to be reduced by approximately 50% if L.O.C. (length of cut) is over 3xD.
Reduce speed and feed recommendations for materials harder than listed.
Recommendations are based on ideal conditions; adjust parameters accordingly for smaller taper machining centers or less rigid conditions.
If product's Length of Cut (L.O.C) is below 2D, it must be applied L.O.C x 90%.
SFM = ft/min, IPT = in/tooth, RPM = rev/min, IPM = in/min.
rows.notes: Table columns mapped to diameters from the header row; values read from pdftotext -layout and checked against the rendered catalog page (printed page 41). Part chosen from the series page as the standard-length square-end item whose length of cut best matches the printed Ap (3D); SD = OD for this size. Table is titled "Side Cutting & Trochoidal Milling" (Ae 0.05D, Ap 3D for every material) - recorded as hem/trochoidal. HHK83/HHK84 corner-radius series share the chart. The series page prints a VDI 3323 hardness table: VDI 31-35 (heat resistant super alloys) HB 200 / 280 / 250 / 350 / 320; VDI 36-37 titanium alloys 400 Rm / 1050 Rm; stainless is listed only as VDI "14" (the cutting-condition table splits 14.1 and 14.2). No hardness is printed in the cutting-condition table itself, so hardness is recorded as not printed.
